Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
8:25 PM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a fast 512 GB SSD and a recent mid-range processor. That combination matters more than a fancy graphics card.

RAM: 16 GB at minimum. Pick one where it can be upgraded later.
Processor: a recent Ryzen 5 or 7, or an Intel Core Ultra 5 or i5. Newer chips run cooler and last longer on battery.
Storage: 512 GB SSD or more.
Screen: full HD, 14 to 15.6 inches, with a bright, matte panel if you can find one.
Keyboard: a comfortable one, since you'll type on it all day.
Graphics card: only needed for machine learning or game development. Otherwise skip it and put the money into the screen and build.

I haven't looked up live prices or AI, so I won't name specific laptops yet. What kind of programming will you do: web and apps, data and machine learning, or games?
